title: Create 3D showcase videos and an end-to-end guide

fields.outcome: Marketing and product teams can turn an AutoTour DOM capture into a restrained, tilted 3D product showcase with a fake browser window and gradient background, and new users can follow one maintained guide from installation through review and CI.
fields.scope: Add an opt-in showcase motion profile with bounded perspective, X/Y tilt, drift, scale, and duration; permit passive clips to hide the cursor; support fixed presentation intervals in DOM-to-WebM rendering; create and inspect a roughly ten-second Agenthouse Services example; and add a packaged end-to-end AutoTour guide. Exclude text overlays, audio, multi-scene editing, and a general video timeline in this slice.
fields.acceptance: A caller can render a DOM replay inside fake window chrome over a gradient while the frame moves through a slow 3D composition, or remains statically tilted under reduced motion. Cursor visibility is configurable. A caller can request a fixed presentation interval without waiting for replay completion. The Agenthouse Services example is readable, uncropped, cursor-free, and approximately ten seconds. The package includes a task-oriented guide covering output choice, journey authoring, capture, showcase video, modular regeneration, CI, and security.
fields.decisions: Apply 3D motion to the browser frame rather than captured application DOM so replay coordinates and focus behavior remain intact. Use one bounded start-to-end animation rather than oscillation. Keep showcase motion opt-in and preserve existing presentation defaults. Treat fixed duration as the interval after player readiness because Playwright video can include startup time in the container.
fields.verification: Assert normalized showcase settings in a real generated player, inspect computed 3D animation and cursor visibility, cover fixed-duration validation and rendering, run all package checks, inspect start/middle/end frames from the live Services capture, probe the WebM dimensions and duration, and run frozen Agenthouse evaluation.
fields.dependencies: Builds on ST-11 presentation framing and DOM-to-WebM rendering plus ST-13 cursor presentation controls.
fields.risks: Strong perspective can crop the frame or reduce readability, and fixed-interval WebM output can include startup overhead. Bound configuration values, recommend conservative tilt and padding, honor reduced motion, inspect representative frames, and measure the encoded artifact.
fields.audience: Marketing, product, and documentation teams creating polished product clips.

criteria.expectation: Presentation profiles can opt into bounded perspective, tilt, drift, scale, and duration on the fake browser frame.
Showcase motion composes with fake window chrome, gradient backgrounds, padding, and shadows without cropping the product view.
Reduced-motion playback uses a stable static tilted composition rather than animated drift.
Passive showcase clips can hide the replay cursor without affecting interactive walkthrough defaults.
DOM-to-WebM rendering can capture a requested presentation interval without waiting for replay completion.
A measured approximately ten-second 1440x900 WebM presents the live Agenthouse Services page with readable, restrained 3D motion.
The published package includes a maintained task-oriented guide from installation and journey authoring through review, regeneration, CI, and security.
